shared_or_similar_visual_information: A right-pointing arrowhead at the end of a horizontal line
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It indicates the positive x direction and the coordinate axis continuing to the right. Right image: It is the right endpoint of a horizontal-distance marker, bounding the indicated span between two adjacent peaks.
Rationales: The arrowheads have similar directions and shapes; one indicates an axis direction and the other bounds the distance between peaks.
